subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should OpenClaw land the narrow staged Wear status bridge first, or sponsor the complete conversation, voice, agent, and session surface in this PR?
rationale: This XL branch introduces a new native application and combines the transport foundation with several product workflows while its narrower staged predecessor remains open, so repository evidence cannot determine the intended rollout order without Android owner direction.

options.title: Land the staged bridge first
options.body: Review and land the narrow status foundation through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803, then submit conversation and voice as a separately reviewed follow-up.

options.title: Sponsor the full Wear surface
options.body: Keep this PR as the landing candidate after fixing Play versioning, release packaging, branding, and voice proof.

recommendation.title: Land the staged bridge first
recommendation.body: Review and land the narrow status foundation through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803, then submit conversation and voice as a separately reviewed follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository documentation explicitly identifies @obviyus as the Android app owner for this native product and release decision.
